neighbours.label: something being kept, stored or held in a place or condition over time (is kept at low temperature, keep it dry at all times), as opposed to other things done to it, and to 'keep' meaning continue or retain
fire: The serum is kept in a sealed vial at the lab.
Seedlings are kept under glass through the winter.
Store the wine in a cool cellar at all times.
The parrot is kept in a cage in the kitchen.
Keep the gate locked and the dog inside at all hours.
The fish are held in a chilled tank until they are sold.
The grain was stored in dry sheds for many months.
Her ashes are kept in an urn on the shelf.
quiet: The serum is tested in a sealed vial at the lab.
Seedlings are planted under glass through the winter.
Open the wine in a cool cellar at the party.
The parrot was bought in a cage in the market.
Keep talking and telling jokes at all your meals.
The fish are cleaned in a chilled tank before they are sold.
The farmer kept the money from the grain for many years.
Her ashes were found in an urn on the shelf.

short: something kept in a maintained condition
